stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model for real-world coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense, rolling out soon. This represents a significant advancement in Google's AI capabilities.

stories.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
stories.explanation: OpenAI disrupted a coordinated campaign to extract protected reasoning from its models, consistent with adversarial distillation. This highlights the ongoing challenge of protecting AI model capabilities and the need for stronger defenses.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
stories.explanation: Google released Gemini 4 Argon, its latest AI model, which is marketed as highly capable for coding, research, writing, and especially cybersecurity work. It is being rolled out to select cyber partners through the Fairwind Program due to its ability to autonomously find, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities.

stories.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
stories.explanation: Barclays is expanding its collaboration with Anthropic to integrate Claude across its global operations, aiming for 50% Claude Code adoption by developers by 2026. This signifies a major enterprise adoption of AI for software development and operational efficiency.

stories.title: From Training to Production, NVIDIA and CoreWeave Close the Loop on Agentic AI
stories.explanation: CoreWeave announced the availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems and NVIDIA Vera CPU, with Cognition as the first customer running production workloads. This signifies the deployment of next-generation NVIDIA infrastructure for agentic AI.

stories.title: The Battle to Be Your Personal AI Agent Is Here
stories.explanation: OpenAI's new 'Dots' personal AI agents, revealed at DevDay, are proactive, always-on assistants that can complete tasks and make autonomous decisions. This launch positions OpenAI in a competitive space with Meta's Muse, vying to be the leading personal AI agent.

stories.title: Trump plan to combat AI risks hinges on Big Tech pals policing themselves
stories.explanation: Two dozen tech firms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta, voluntarily agreed to implement safety controls and undergo independent audits for frontier AI models as part of a new US government initiative.

stories.title: Productive, Durable, Fungible: How NVIDIA AI Factories Maximize Return on Investment
stories.explanation: NVIDIA details how its AI factories are engineered to maximize return on investment by focusing on earning capacity, durability, and fungibility. This matters for companies investing in large-scale AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Trump’s AI Safety ‘Accord’ Is a Fancy Pinky-Swear
stories.explanation: Six major AI companies (Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, xAI, Nvidia) signed 'The White House Accord on Super Intelligence,' a voluntary agreement to implement safeguards for AI models. This signifies an industry-wide commitment to self-regulation, though it is not a formal regulation.

stories.title: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
stories.explanation: Microsoft Research developed a machine learning system that forecasts space-weather risk across 66,935 substations in the continental United States. This system can predict where damage is likely to occur 30-60 minutes before a storm, helping grid operators respond.
